name: JW Marriott Hotel Hangzhou
positioning: City-center luxury hotel in Hangzhou with Hangzhou-inspired room design, marble bathrooms, some West Lake views and an Executive Lounge overlooking West Lake
best_for: Travelers who want a central Hangzhou base near the subway
Guests who want Executive Lounge access and lake-view rooms or suites

facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of Hangzhou's city center.
Nearby subway stations include Wulin Square Station on Line 1 and Wulinmen Station on Line 2.
Rooms include a mounted bathroom TV and luxury bath products.
The Executive Lounge serves a full breakfast, snacks and refreshments through the day, and cocktails and light meals in the evening.
The hotel has a heated pool.
The fitness center has sauna and steam rooms.
The hotel has four restaurants, including a signature steakhouse.
Man Ho serves Cantonese fare and has private dining rooms.
The hotel has almost 20,000 square feet of venue space and a grand ballroom.

highlights.text: The Executive Lounge overlooks West Lake and has city views of downtown Hangzhou.
Some accommodations have views of West Lake and the downtown Hangzhou skyline.
The Premier Suite is a one-bedroom suite with a lake view and Executive Lounge access.
Cru Steak House, the signature restaurant, serves prime cuts of beef, fresh-caught seafood and an extensive wine list.

considerations.text: West Lake views are offered from only some accommodations.
Hangzhou Xiaoshan International Airport is about 30 km from the hotel.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the high-end positioning.
